rules.title: California statewide rent cap (Tenant Protection Act rent limits, SB 567 version)
rules.requirement: Landlords of covered units may not raise rent more than 5% plus the local percentage change in the cost of living, or 10%, whichever is lower, over any 12-month period, and no more than two increments in that period. The initial rent for a new tenancy is not capped, and rent-increase notices must follow Civ. Code § 827.
rules.requirement_es: Los propietarios de unidades cubiertas no pueden aumentar la renta más del 5% más el cambio porcentual del costo de vida local, o el 10%, lo que sea menor, en cualquier período de 12 meses, y no en más de dos incrementos en ese período. La renta inicial de un nuevo arrendamiento no tiene límite, y los avisos de aumento deben cumplir con el Código Civil § 827.
rules.quoted_span: an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower
rules.effective_date_quote: This section shall become operative on April 1, 2024.
rules.key_value: 5% + CPI change, max 10%, per 12 months; max two increases per 12 months
rules.exemptions: Deed-restricted/subsidized affordable housing; dormitories; housing under stricter local rent control; housing with a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years (except mobilehomes); separately alienable property (e.g., single-family homes, condos) if owner is not a REIT, corporation, LLC with a corporate member, or mobilehome park management and proper written notice is given; owner-occupied duplexes (not ADUs/JADUs); mobilehome homeowners.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential real property statewide (including mobilehome park tenancies), except exempt categories; sunset January 1, 2030.
rules.penalty: Civil action for injunctive relief, damages equal to the excess rent, attorney's fees and costs, and up to three times the excess if willful, oppressive, fraudulent or malicious; enforceable by Attorney General, city attorney or county counsel.
rules.caveat: Section was effective January 1, 2024 but operative April 1, 2024 by its own terms; it is repealed as of January 1, 2030. The percentage change in cost of living is recomputed yearly from regional CPI.
